subject: general
question:
What will the value of the following expression be?

20 – [15 – {4 – (8 – 6 + 3)}]
solution:
**Given:**

20 – [15 – {4 – (8 – 6 + 3)}]

**Concept used:**

BODMAS

B - Brackets

O - Of

D - Division

M - Multiplication

A - Addition

S - Subtraction

Preference will be done on the basis of the letter coming first in the word BODMAS.

**Calculations:**

20 – [15 – {4 – (8 – 6 + 3)}]

= 20 - [15 - {4 - (11 - 6)}]

= 20 - [15 - {4 - 5}]

= 20 - [15 - {- 1}]

= 20 - [15 + 1 ]

= 20 - 16

= 4

**Hence, The value is 4.**
